details:
So now at the EAC update is live all mods and clients have been taken away at first I was really upset with this until y’all released the developer update and that made me really happy but most of the mods that I would like on there and other content creators would like on there we’re not on there and this is just a suggestion to add a few of those! 
Such as
For starters camera animations it is great for content creators so we can have our cameras follow us so we can make TikTok‘s YouTube videos or we could stream it on twitch or caffeine or any other platform! 
Then I want to talk about freeze-frame, freeze-frame if you haven’t heard about it before you can go into whatever avatar you want and you can have it freeze in place or play in animation this is great for TikTok‘s and YouTube videos mainly because some people don’t have a lot of friends or their CPU or GPU are really bad and showing many peoples avatars at one time can crash them this is a great alternative to having more people!
Anti-crashers, Anticrashers are really important after the new update y’all implemented we no longer have those things and there are a lot of photon crashers being used unfortunately. I would really appreciate if y’all implemented more anti-crashers into the game for the community! 
IK tweaks, now I know that y’all already have IK tweaks but they aren’t as good as the mod was I know y’all were trying hard on the version y’all released but it just wasn’t good enough and a mod could do it better. Now that mods have been taken away a lot of people‘s full body tracking has been messed up for users that use kinect full body, tundra trackers, slime VR, and many others. Taking away the mod really messed up peoples immersiveness and it made a lot of people upset. 
Unlimited avatar favorites, with this mod I could save any avatars that I want and unlimited amount. I feel doing this would benefit the VR chat community quite a bit. Especially the content creators, and for the VR chat Devs that are thinking that why would we want to add this this would be bad for VRC plus. Well. I understand that but I’m sure that it would bring more people back to the platform AND don’t put it in the VRC plus package in the VRC plus package y’all should add more to it like being able to change colors to your profile or change colors of your UI menu! Personally I know me and many others would subscribe to VRC plus, if it had those features.
Avatar search, Avatar search is very important to many it’s easier for us to find avatars by name like let’s say I accidentally unfavored one of my favorite avatars and now I cannot longer find it well if I remember the name I could search it up but y’all do not have that feature. This feature would be very appreciated.
Avatar recents, this is very simple it’s in the name it would just show all of your recent avatars. 
Nameplate colors, I feel like we should add nameplate colors and to be specific with that I feel that not all nameplates should be gray I would appreciate it and many others would too if y’all would add name plate colors such as whenever you’re a trusted your nameplate is purple, if you’re known it’s orange, user green, new user light blue, visitor grey, nuisance black or dark grey. 
With the mods y’all added so far I feel like y’all have done an amazing job with it! But there is so much more to add. I hope the devs and whoever is reading this do you understand why I ask for these to be implemented. Most of these are for content creators or are quality of life mods! If you have any questions or concerns please reply to this. 
Thank you for your time,
Liquid,
title: Now that the EAC, I would appreciate a few mods that I used to have!
